paragraphs: Rabbah son of Rav Idi bar Avin. He prepared a fine calf [עגלא תלתא] (Shabbat 136a, chapter Milah). The passage simply says that Rav Idi bar Avin’s son prepared it on the seventh day after its birth for Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua. They told him, “Had you waited until tonight, we would have eaten from it.” In Asheri the reading is ‘Rava his son.’
